prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / game sprite sheet. Create a production TRANSPARENT-background pixel-art sprite sheet containing exactly TWO isolated furniture props, side-by-side with a very large empty transparent gap. No room/background/floor. NO labels, no text, no logos, no border.
LEFT PROP: one TALL ROUND STANDING COCKTAIL TABLE for a Korean underground live rock club. Circular warm dark amber wooden tabletop with a subtle black rim, viewed from a fixed high isometric/orthographic game camera looking down about35degrees (tabletop appears a horizontal ellipse, width about1.8times its height). One slim matte black steel central pedestal, circular wide weighted black metal footbase resting on the floor. Tall enough for a standing adult's waist. No glasses, no drinks, no decor. Table is centered in the left half, entirely visible from tabletop to footbase. The furniture should read as about1.1metres tall with a1.1metre diameter top.
RIGHT PROP: one HIGH BAR STOOL matching the table. Round burgundy-red padded seat with subtle warm highlight and dark rim, four slim black/dark silver metal legs, a circular metal footrest/rung, clearly tall bar-stool proportions, NO backrest. Same isometric orthographic camera, roundseat shown as horizontal ellipse. Entirestool fromcushion tofloorcontacts visible, centered inright half. About.85metre seatheight and .5metre diameter seat. Draw with exactly same pixel scale as lefttable, so stool is visibly narrower and slightly shorter than table.
STYLE: carefully hand-pixelled 16-bit indiegame production art, crisp hard pixel clusters and clean silhouette, no fuzzy edges or painted texture, no smooth3D render. Limitedwarmdarkwood/charcoal/burgundy/steel palette, amber light upperleft and restrained coolblue rim on right for a dim indie-rock venue. Enough detail to remain identifiable after reduction to table40x46pixels and stool24x34pixels. No castshadows extending far outside bases (small attached contactshadow acceptable). Bothobjects separated, no touching, no clipping, no duplicates, no extra chairs/table. Transparent alpha throughout outside props. Wide3:2canvas composition, ampletransparentmargins allaround andbetween.
